blueprint.title: Balanced-Arm Desk Lamp
blueprint.summary: A real-scale balanced-arm desk lamp with a heavy steel base, two aluminium arms, twin arm springs, an elbow pivot, and a conical shade containing an LED disc. The geometry is proportioned for stable desk use with the shade angled down toward the work surface.

parts.name: BASE-01
parts.role: Weighted round steel base providing stability and anchoring the lamp to the desk
parts.shape: Cylinder with shallow top recess and bottom chamfer; central bore for pivot boss
parts.size: 180 mm diameter, 25 mm high, 20 mm central recess diameter, 8 mm deep
parts.position: center at (0, 12.5, 0), bottom face at y = 0

parts.name: PIVOT-02
parts.role: Central vertical pivot boss carrying the lower arm and permitting side-to-side rotation
parts.shape: Cylinder with two side clevis lugs cut from box shapes; pin bore through both lugs
parts.size: 36 mm diameter, 45 mm high, lugs 10 mm thick, pin bore 10 mm diameter
parts.position: center at (0, 47.5, 0), seated in base recess

parts.name: LOWER-ARM-03
parts.role: First straight aluminium arm segment transferring load from pivot to elbow joint
parts.shape: Rectangular aluminium tube extruded along inclined axis; boolean end clevis holes and two lightening slots
parts.size: 380 mm long, 25 mm wide, 35 mm tall, 3 mm wall
parts.position: centerline from (0, 70, 0) to (0, 231, 344); part center at (0, 150.5, 172)

parts.name: LOWER-SPRING-04
parts.role: Compression spring along the lower arm to assist balanced-arm motion
parts.shape: Linear array of tori around a thin core cylinder, trimmed at ends to form a coil spring
parts.size: 280 mm long, 16 mm coil diameter, 3.5 mm wire diameter, 4 mm pitch
parts.position: mounted above lower arm, center at (0, 175, 172), aligned with lower-arm axis

parts.name: ELBOW-05
parts.role: Elbow joint connecting lower and upper arms and allowing the lamp to fold
parts.shape: Cylinder with axis along X, two end caps, and central bore for upper-arm pin
parts.size: 50 mm diameter, 45 mm wide, 10 mm pin bore

parts.name: UPPER-ARM-06
parts.role: Second straight aluminium arm segment carrying the shade toward the work surface
parts.shape: Rectangular aluminium tube extruded along slightly downward axis; boolean end clevis and cable clearance hole
parts.size: 300 mm long, 25 mm wide, 35 mm tall, 3 mm wall
parts.position: centerline from (0, 231, 344) to (0, 169, 637); part center at (0, 200, 490.5)

parts.name: UPPER-SPRING-07
parts.role: Compression spring along the upper arm balancing the shade weight
parts.shape: Linear array of tori around a thin core cylinder, trimmed at ends to form a coil spring
parts.size: 240 mm long, 14 mm coil diameter, 3 mm wire diameter, 4 mm pitch
parts.position: mounted above upper arm, center at (0, 225, 490.5), aligned with upper-arm axis

parts.name: SHADE-YOKE-08
parts.role: Mounting clevis at the upper-arm end that carries the shade and allows tilt
parts.shape: Small cylinder with two side fork lugs; pin bore and shade-thread boss
parts.size: 30 mm diameter, 40 mm wide, 8 mm pin bore, M20 shade boss
parts.position: center at (0, 169, 637), attached to upper-arm end

parts.name: SHADE-09
parts.role: Conical shade directing LED light downward and shielding the light source
parts.shape: Revolved conical frustum profile with inner cone boolean cut, rear mounting neck, and central LED aperture
parts.size: 140 mm long, 60 mm rear diameter, 190 mm mouth diameter, 2 mm wall
parts.position: rear center at (0, 169, 637), frustum center at (0, 129, 694), axis tilted 35 degrees downward from +Z

parts.name: LED-DISC-10
parts.role: Circular LED light source seated inside the shade
parts.shape: Thin cylinder with chamfered edge and central mounting boss
parts.size: 50 mm diameter, 8 mm thick, 10 mm mounting boss
parts.position: center at (0, 162, 647), axis aligned with shade axis

callouts: Lower arm rises 25 degrees above horizontal; upper arm drops about 12 degrees toward the shade.
Spring coils are shown simplified as torus arrays for modeling; real springs would be helical wire.
Shade axis is tilted 35 degrees downward from the horizontal forward direction.
LED disc sits 10 mm inside the shade rear opening to reduce glare.
Base mass should be sufficient to resist tipping when the shade is fully extended forward.
